error_summary: ForecastBench adapter rejected an empty background string because it required non-empty text. The official ForecastBench QuestionFrame requires background to be a string but does not impose a non-empty constraint.
methodological_disposition: Technical compatibility failure only. No forecast result exists and no predictive inference may be drawn. Fix is restricted to aligning background validation with the official public ForecastBench schema. A new technical validation/freeze and separate Gate-4 authorization are required before another real attempt.
